summary.content:
Today's selection covers 101 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 56 on Artificial Intelligence and 19 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: AI Conundrum: Why MCP Security Can't Be Patched Away
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Critical Langflow Vulnerability Exploited Hours After Public Disclosure
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Dark Reading, SecurityWeek, The Verge, TechCrunch, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 48 articles published in the last 24 hours
